# RO by HAA&D – furnished apartment, Prenzlauer Berg

> Fully furnished 35 m² one-bedroom apartment on Stubbenkammerstraße near Helmholtzplatz, Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin (10437). Rented to one person for 2 to 6 months as temporary housing (Wohnen auf Zeit), not as a holiday rental. Owner-managed by architect Hagar Abiri; the flat was once the studio of her practice HAA&D (https://hagarabiri.com).

- Separate bedroom, full kitchen, washing machine, fast Wi-Fi, large work table, bed linen and towels, courtyard garden
- 1920s building, quiet street, large north-east windows with a garden view
- Rent on request, all bills included (heating, electricity, water, internet); deposit of one month's rent due within 3 days of booking
- Registration (Anmeldung) possible: landlord confirmation provided
- Transport: S-Bahn Prenzlauer Allee (S41/S42 Ringbahn) 5 min walk, tram M2 2 min, tram M10 5 min
- Suited to: people relocating to Berlin for work, international students, interns, temporary work assignments
